title: Tenant onboarding: Latency & cost snapshot card for private clusters
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact, embeddable 'Tenant Snapshot' card shown in Private Console cluster overview and onboarding flows. The card surfaces: 1) 95th percentile latency to the tenant's VPC endpoints (region and cross-region breakdown), 2) projected per-hour token cost estimate for current model profile and recent QPS, 3) an action button to run a 'network preflight check' that triggers a synthetic probe and returns a short health summary, and 4) a lightweight signal for recommended optimizations (suggested batching or a quantized model variant). Design should prioritize clarity for platform engineers and product owners during onboarding, and be usable in narrow sidebars and wider overview panels.
acceptance_criteria: Card fits in 360px sidebar width and in 920px overview layout without content truncation
Latency metric shows region + cross-region 95p and last-24h trend sparkline
Cost projection uses last 1h QPS + selected model profile to estimate hourly token spend and shows confidence band
Network preflight action executes existing probe workflow (backend) and returns pass/warn/fail with link to detailed diagnostics
Card includes CTA to open 'Optimization suggestions' modal; suggestions come from telemetry rules defined by Optimize team
Accessibility: color contrast >= 4.5:1 for key status chips; all interactive elements keyboard-focusable and announced by screen readers
Telemetry: click events, probe run id, selected model variant, and suggestion acceptance should emit console.instrumentation events
constraints: Backend probe API returns max 5 results and resolves in <5s; card should show spinner for up to 6s then fallback to 'Try again'
No new backend endpoints can be added in this sprint; use existing /internal/probes/run and /billing/estimate endpoints
Design must reuse console status color tokens and iconography
Do not duplicate existing 'cluster health' dashboard; this is a lightweight per-tenant summary
